name: Links to Iframes Filter
description: A text-format filter that replaces ADMIN-CONFIGURED links with admin-defined iframe embed markup (a curated link→iframe mapping, not arbitrary user URLs). Restrict who can edit the mappings and who gets the text format, since the iframe markup is admin-supplied and rendered.
project_description:
Provides a Drupal text filter that replaces configured links with iframe markup.

 Back to top 

 What it does
 
 
 Stores link to iframe replacements in a custom database table. 
 Adds a text filter plugin: Replace links with iframes . 
 When enabled on a text format, matching links in processed text are replaced with the configured iframe markup. 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements
 
 
 Drupal 10 or 11 
 Core filter module (declared as a dependency) 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation
 
 
 Enable the module. 
 Rebuild caches. 
 
 Back to top 

 Configuration
 
 
 Go to: /admin/config/content/links-to-iframes 
 
 Add one or more replacements:
 
 Link 
 Iframe 
 
 
 Save replacements. 
 
 Back to top 

 Enable the filter on a text format
 
 
 Go to: /admin/config/content/formats 
 
 Edit the text format you want. 
 Enable Replace links with iframes . 
 Save the text format. 
 
 Back to top 

 Matching behavior
 
 
 Matches anchors by exact href value. 
 Replacement runs only where that text format is applied. 
 
 Back to top

 Back to top 

 Data storage
 
 
 Data is stored in table: links_to_iframes_filter 
 
 Cache tag used by the filter: links_to_iframes_filter:mappings 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Testing
 
 phpunit tests area available in the /tests folder.
